known_defects.defect: Postgres receives the write and read arrowheads at cols 36 and 38, two cells apart, and the two approach runs sit on the same row separated by one empty cell.

known_defects.defect: The 'read' label sits on row 35 at cols 42-45, four cells left of its own vertical at col 49, inside the free space between the write stem (col 23) and the read line.
known_defects.impact: in plain text the label is nearer the gap than the line; ANSI shows it does not touch either route
known_defects.status: unfixed (shortening or moving it would need another spec attempt)

known_defects.defect: During animation a flow dot can replace a route corner glyph, e.g. the enqueue elbow at row 20 col 23 in captures/view1-live-frame1.txt renders as '●' instead of '╭'.

known_defects.status: renderer behaviour of the frozen binary, not spec-controllable

known_defects.status: theme mapping of the frozen binary; gruvbox is required by the source, so the spec does not change it
